title: Tree Constructions for the l1 Distortion of Binary Edit Distance

abstractEnglish: We give two independent constructions of binary words of one length at most d whose ordinary edit-distance metrics require ℓ1 distortion $`\exp(\Omega(\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d}))`$ for every sufficiently large d. We also prove a constant-distortion binary conversion for one prescribed input length. Together with the companion upper embedding theorem, these lower bounds determine the order of logarithmic distortion uniformly over finite alphabets with at least two symbols.
titleEn: Tree Constructions for the l1 Distortion of Binary Edit Distance
titleZh: 二进制编辑距离ℓ1扭曲的树构造

details.overview: 稿件给出两种独立构造，对每个充分大的d，产生长度至多d的等长二进制词，其普通编辑距离度量需要ℓ1扭曲exp(Ω(√(log d log log d)))。作者还证明了一个针对指定输入长度的常数扭曲二进制转换。结合伴随的上嵌入定理，这些下界在至少两个符号的有限字母表上一致确定了对数扭曲的阶。
keyPoints: 两种独立构造给出二进制词编辑距离的ℓ1扭曲下界。
下界为exp(Ω(√(log d log log d)))，对充分大d成立。
结合上嵌入定理，确定有限字母表上对数扭曲的阶。
